scenarios.description: Situation artifact + municipalities vertical + offer_posture free-asset produces a complete EB-format JSON artifact.
assertions: output artifact file written to path matching 'docs/campaigns/(nites|labs)/copy-*.json' (short-form canonical per BC-8719)

scenarios.description: No situation artifact supplied — skill must run the value-equation interview before writing copy.
assertions: first_response mentions at least 3 of: 'Dream Outcome', 'Perceived Likelihood', 'Time Delay', 'Effort', 'Sacrifice'
first_tool_calls does NOT contain Write of 'docs/campaigns/nites/copy-*.json'
no output artifact written until operator responds to the interview questions

scenarios.description: Operator supplies a draft body containing '{{firstname}}' — skill must self-correct to '{FIRST_NAME}'.

input.operator_draft_body: Hi {{firstname}}, I saw your downtown plan.

scenarios.description: Operator-supplied proof point contains em-dashes — output must sanitize them out of both step bodies.

input.operator_proof_point: foot traffic rose — up 40% — year over year

scenarios.description: docs/marketing-context.md is absent — skill must hard-gate before emitting any artifact.
assertions: first_response does NOT write a JSON artifact
first_response mentions 'marketing-context' OR asks for 'entity' explicitly
first_tool_calls does NOT contain Write of 'docs/campaigns/*/copy-*.json'

scenarios.description: Operator supplies vertical=hoas (no preset file shipped yet) — skill falls back to base inline skeleton and surfaces the BC-5879 reference.
assertions: output artifact file is written (fallback succeeds, not halted)
output.step_1.body matches base inline skeleton shape, not a vertical-override variant

scenarios.description: Operator supplies situation + entity but omits offer_posture — skill must prompt with entity-aware recommendation before emitting.
assertions: first_response references entity-aware recommendation (e.g. 'brite-nites' maps to 'free-asset')
first_tool_calls does NOT contain Write of 'docs/campaigns/nites/copy-*.json'
no JSON artifact emitted until operator confirms the posture

scenarios.description: Operator (or upstream skill) supplies legacy offer_tier integer 2 instead of offer_posture — skill MUST accept the legacy field (read-side backward-compat per ADR-017), map 2 → free-asset, emit a deprecation warning naming ADR-017 + the 6-month deprecation window, and write the artifact with offer_posture=free-asset on the new field.
assertions: output artifact written to expected path
